name: Asami Mao
source:
Her smile is her best quality, and it’s something that everyone in Kiyoku High School loves. She’s the girl with the best smile that will melt even the coldest heart, Asami Mao. Besides her cheerful, caring, and energetic nature, her abundant love for felines makes her seem even cuter. Adding to Asami Mao’s good qualities is the fact that she is a good engineer—she builds cute feline robots flawlessly. How perfect can she be? None would doubt her perfection, unless they happen to know about the big hollow left in her heart, a hollow so big that she can barely feel an emotion at all. Her encounters with Kazuya change her little by little, as she gradually feels that Kazuya has the same pain as she does, if only not much bigger.

[Taken from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/63024782/la-memoire-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
